tariq: hey — quick Q on Notion templates for the EMEA onboarding pack. i drafted a localized checklist (UK spellings, regional links). where should language-specific variants live? /Templates/engineering or somewhere under Team Docs?

elena-devex: welcome Tariq! short answer: templates that are company-wide live in /Templates/engineering and can include localized variants as separate templates (eg `onboarding-uk`, `onboarding-eu`). if it's strictly team-specific, keep it under /Team Docs/Engineering/Infra and request publishing.

tariq: cool. if i create a copy in My Pages then request publication, will the template button work for other people globally?

lars-docs: you should NOT move a draft into /Templates yourself. workflow: draft in My Pages -> `@doc-bot new-template <link> brief` -> docs maintainers will validate properties and publish to /Templates/engineering so the Template button is configured correctly for everyone. we also confirm the localized title and tags.

tariq: got it. question about naming convention for localized templates? should we include region suffix or language code?

mimi-localization: we prefer `team - purpose - region` in the human title (eg `eng-infra - New hire checklist - UK`) and a slug like `eng-infra/new-hire-checklist.uk`. For language variants use ISO codes for slugs (e.g., `.en-GB`). Add a page property `Locale: en-GB` so the docs indexer can surface the right template for people in that region.

elena-devex: also add `Tags: onboarding, locale:UK` (multi-select) so search filters can work. avoid duplicating large media between variants; link to a canonical assets page instead.

tariq: if i request publication, can i ask for temporary Editor rights on the template in /Templates/engineering to iterate with reviewers?

lars-docs: yes — include `duration:7d` in the bot request, e.g. `@doc-bot new-template <link> brief duration:7d`. maintainers typically grant Editor for up to 7 days for iteration. note: make changes in your draft; maintainers will publish the final page to keep template metadata consistent.

tariq: last one — will moving a page break backlinks or mentions for people who bookmarked the draft?

mimi-localization: moving preserves comments/backlinks. only caution: if you rename slugs or change property schema after publishing, the indexer may need a reindex. run `@doc-bot reindex <link>` if you change Locale/Tags.

doc-bot: Action logged: new-template request created by tariq for https://redwood.notion.so/tariq/emea-onboarding-draft. Ticket DOCS-891 assigned to docs-maintainers. Requested duration: 7d. Lint: pending.

tariq: awesome — i'll finish the draft, set Locale and Tags, then ping the bot. thanks! :raised_hands:

(reacted with :thumbsup: by elena-devex)
